quotes.text: It comes from planning discipline, specifically, three non negotiable steps define and contain scope, secure data quality, and implement governance from day one.
quotes.speaker: Mirko Peters
quotes.why: States the episode's core framework of three non-negotiable steps.

quotes.text: Start by asking one deceptively simple question, what decisions should this report enable? Not what data you have, but what business question needs answering. Every metric should trace back to that question.
quotes.speaker: Mirko Peters
quotes.why: Gives a practical, decision-first rule for scoping reports.

quotes.text: Treat data quality as infrastructure, not decoration. No one thanks you for a healthy foundation, but they will blame you for every crack.
quotes.speaker: Mirko Peters
quotes.why: Memorable framing of why data quality must be treated as infrastructure.

quotes.text: Governance is not a constraint, it's scaffolding. It doesn't limit innovation. It lets it survive without collapsing under its own enthusiasm.
quotes.speaker: Mirko Peters
quotes.why: Reframes governance as an enabler rather than a blocker.

quotes.text: Start every new project with two artifacts, a scoping template and a governance checklist. Ten minutes with those documents saves months of apology tours.
quotes.speaker: Mirko Peters
quotes.why: Concrete, actionable recommendation for starting any Power BI project.

chapters.title: Step one: Define and contain scope
Step two: Secure data quality and consistency
Step three: Implement governance from day one

takeaways: Most Power BI projects fail because of missing planning, not because of DAX or visuals: scope, data quality and governance must come first.
Contain scope creep with a decision-focused requirements workshop, a written scoping template and formal change requests for every new wish.
Treat data quality as infrastructure and establish governance with roles, row-level security, life cycle policies and documentation from day one.
hook: Many Power BI rollouts produce colourful dashboards that change no decisions. This episode shows BI leads, analysts and project owners the three non-negotiable steps of scope, data quality and governance that turn Power BI projects into reliable decision tools.
